ios.desc:
SoundlyFM player brings back the timeless charm of classic radio, reimagined for the minimalist age.

Globally Player
- Explore radio stations and ambient channels from around the world.
Radio Alarm Clock
- Play your favorite radio station at regular intervals throughout the day to wake you up.
Designed for Calm
- Clean interface, smooth playback, no distractions.
Your Companion in Sound
- From morning focus to late-night comfort, find a station for every mood.
Simply Beautiful 
- Inspired by vintage radios, crafted with minimalist design.

Whether you’re working, reading, or winding down, Soundly FM stays quietly by your side — one sound at a time.

SoundlyFM is an internet radio player that allows users to discover and play publicly available live streams.
The app does not host, store, or distribute any content.
It functions as a client interface to freely available online radio streams.

show_hn.title: Show HN: SoundlyFM, a minimal radio app for background listening

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I built SoundlyFM, a minimal radio app for people who like live radio as background sound while working, driving, or studying.

I wanted something very simple. No playlists, no recommendations, no endless choices. Just live voices playing in real time.

Before this, I tried physical radios, large streaming platforms, and various radio apps. None of them felt right. Some were noisy or limited, some were overwhelming, and many were filled with ads.

SoundlyFM is designed around a few specific use cases.

- On macOS, it lives in the menu bar and starts playing with one click.

- On iPhone, it supports background playback and a sleep timer.

- In the car, it works well over Bluetooth, with quick station switching and access to local traffic radio.

The app is intentionally not algorithm driven.
Stations are manually curated, closer to old school radio than a modern content feed.
The interface is very minimal, play, pause, switch station, favorite. No ads.

It supports both iOS and macOS and includes thousands of global stations, which I continue maintaining and expanding based on feedback.

Landing page: https://soundlyfm.com/

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6754501543

I built this mainly for myself and use it daily, especially on macOS.
Happy to hear feedback or answer questions.
